hero.subtitle: Cafe · European Kitchen
hero.tagline: A small European kitchen at the end of an old freight line — slow mornings, lantern-lit evenings, and a kitchen that doesn't rush.

about.title: Built inside an old freight house.
about.body1: The Terminal sits at the quiet end of a forgotten railway line — once used to stage parcels for the morning train, now serving European classics under the slow turn of brass cogs. Salvaged oak, lime-washed brick, two skylights, and a single brass lamp from the original station office.
about.body2: Our kitchen carries the dishes our great-grandparents walked across borders with — Vienna's schnitzel, Budapest's goulash, Lyon's confit — plated as if for the dining car of the Orient Express. Every plate is a postcard. Every coffee, a ticket.
about.quote: “ The journey is the meal, and the meal is the journey. ”
about.imageAlt: Vintage railway café interior with warm lantern light and timber surfaces

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: A short kitchen with long memory — tap any dish for the chef's notes.

cold-cut-plate.name: Cold Cut Plate
cold-cut-plate.desc: Parma ham, mortadella, salami ventrencia, salami milano, cashew nut, raisin, cracker, pineapple jam
cold-cut-plate.notes: A platter of cured meats and delicacies: aged Parma ham, mortadella, two distinct salamis, roasted cashews, golden raisins, house-made crackers, and a tart pineapple jam to balance the richness.

cheese-plate.name: Cheese Plate
cheese-plate.desc: Gorgonzola cheese, piattone cheese, taleggio cheese, Manchego cheese, cashew nut, raisin, cracker, pineapple jam
cheese-plate.notes: Four European cheeses—the sharp blue of Gorgonzola, creamy Piattone, soft-washed taleggio, and nutty Manchego—paired with roasted cashews, raisins, crackers, and house-made pineapple jam.
cheese-plate.pairing: A fine Barolo or aged Cheddar.

parma-burrata.name: Parma & Burrata
parma-burrata.desc: Parma ham, burrata cheese, rocket, bread
parma-burrata.notes: Paper-thin 36-month Parma ham draped over creamy burrata, peppery arugula, and warm sourdough toast. Simplicity at its finest.

beef-carpaccio.name: Beef Carpaccio
beef-carpaccio.desc: Beef tenderloin, rocket, kumquat dressing, Padano cheese
beef-carpaccio.notes: Razor-thin slices of raw beef tenderloin, peppery rocket, shaved Padano, and a bright citrus kumquat dressing. Elegant, refined, raw.

bruschetta-smoked-salmon.name: Bruschetta Smoked Salmon
bruschetta-smoked-salmon.notes: Toasted bread layered with sour cream, cold-smoked salmon, and fresh dill. A classic pairing, executed with care.

bruschetta-parma.name: Bruschetta Parma
bruschetta-parma.desc: Bread, tomato, parma ham, ricotta cheese
bruschetta-parma.notes: Toasted bread spread with creamy ricotta, topped with sweet tomato and delicate Parma ham. A light, refined starter.

garden-salad.name: Garden Salad
garden-salad.desc: Mixed salad, potato, cherry tomato, red onion, cucumber, broccoli, balsamic sauce
garden-salad.notes: A fresh composition of garden greens, boiled potatoes, cherry tomatoes, red onion, crisp cucumber, and steamed broccoli, tossed in aged balsamic vinaigrette.

tropical-fruit-salad-burrata.name: Tropical Fruit Salad & Burrata
tropical-fruit-salad-burrata.desc: Mixed salad, yellow orange, melon, grape, red dragon fruit, pineapple, cherry tomato, kumquat dressing
tropical-fruit-salad-burrata.notes: A bright seasonal salad of tropical and stone fruits—orange, melon, grapes, dragon fruit, pineapple, cherry tomatoes—finished with creamy burrata and a citrus kumquat dressing.

smoked-salmon-salad.name: Smoked Salmon Salad
smoked-salmon-salad.desc: Mixed salad, rocket, melon, cherry tomato, smoked salmon, balsamic sauce
smoked-salmon-salad.notes: Garden greens, peppery rocket, sweet melon, cherry tomato, cold-smoked salmon, tossed in aged balsamic. Fresh, briny, elegant.

pumpkin-soup.name: Creamy Pumpkin Soup
pumpkin-soup.desc: Roasted pumpkin bisque, nutmeg, ginger, bread
pumpkin-soup.notes: A silky roasted pumpkin bisque finished with nutmeg and a whisper of ginger, served with warm buttered bread. Comfort in a bowl.

mushroom-soup.name: Creamy Mushroom Soup
mushroom-soup.desc: Trio of slow-cooked mushrooms, cream, bread
mushroom-soup.notes: Three kinds of mushroom slow-cooked into a velvety cream soup—earthy and deep—served with warm buttered bread.

spinach-stuffed-chicken-breast.name: Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breast
spinach-stuffed-chicken-breast.desc: Chicken breast, spinach, cashew nut, ricotta cheese, Demi sauce, mixed salad
spinach-stuffed-chicken-breast.notes: Tender chicken breast filled with wilted spinach and creamy ricotta, topped with roasted cashews, finished with a light demi-glace sauce. Served with fresh salad.
spinach-stuffed-chicken-breast.pairing: A glass of light Pinot Noir.

pan-seared-salmon.name: Pan Seared Salmon
pan-seared-salmon.desc: Salmon, broccoli, asparagus, Mix Mushroom, beurre blanc sauce
pan-seared-salmon.notes: Wild salmon fillet seared until the skin crisps, served on a bed of steamed broccoli and asparagus with sautéed mushrooms, finished with silky beurre blanc.

ribeye-hokube-steaks.name: Ribeye Hokube Steaks
ribeye-hokube-steaks.desc: Ribeye hokube, Mix mushroom, Garlic, Pepper sauce
ribeye-hokube-steaks.notes: Premium Japanese Hokube ribeye, dry-aged for depth, seared until rare, topped with a trio of sautéed mushrooms, roasted garlic, finished with a bold peppercorn sauce.

usda-striploin-steaks.name: USDA Striploin Steaks
usda-striploin-steaks.desc: Striploin steaks, Mix mushroom, Garlic, Red wine sauce
usda-striploin-steaks.notes: USDA Prime striploin, char-grilled to your liking, served with sautéed mushroom medley, roasted garlic cloves, finished with a rich red wine reduction.

top-blade-aukube-steaks.name: Top Blade Aukube Steaks
top-blade-aukube-steaks.desc: Top Blade Aukube, Mix Mushroom, Garlic, Broccoli, Mushroom sauce
top-blade-aukube-steaks.notes: Tender Australian Aukube top blade, a prized cut for its marbling and depth, served with sautéed mushrooms, roasted garlic, steamed broccoli, and a rich mushroom sauce.

german-sausage.name: German Sausage
german-sausage.notes: Authentic German bratwurst, snapped from the grill, served with tangy house pickles and a bold smoky BBQ sauce. A crowd-pleaser from the old continent.

lamb-sausage.name: Lamb Sausage
lamb-sausage.notes: Hand-seasoned lamb sausage with herbs and spices, grilled until caramelized, served with house pickles and tangy BBQ sauce. Rich, aromatic, satisfying.

hickory-sausage.name: Hickory Sausage
hickory-sausage.notes: Slow-smoked over hickory wood for hours, this sausage carries deep, complex smoke notes. Served with crisp house pickles and classic BBQ sauce.

crispy-chicken-burger.name: Crispy Chicken Burger
crispy-chicken-burger.desc: Burger bun, chicken thigh, cheddar cheese salad, tomato, pickle, honey mustard sauce, french fries
crispy-chicken-burger.notes: Juicy chicken thigh fried until golden, melted cheddar, crisp lettuce, ripe tomato, tangy pickle, house-made honey mustard, all nestled in a toasted bun. Served with hand-cut fries.

beef-burger.name: Beef Burger
beef-burger.desc: Burger bun, beef patty, cheddar cheese, salad, tomato, pickle, spicy garlic mayo, french fries
beef-burger.notes: Thick-cut beef patty on a toasted bun with melted cheddar, fresh lettuce, tomato, pickle, and a fiery spiced garlic mayo. Hand-cut fries on the side.

seafood-pasta.name: Seafood Pasta
seafood-pasta.desc: Spaghetti, shrimp, squid, mussel, squid ink, shrimp bisque, chilli, garlic, parsley
seafood-pasta.notes: House-made spaghetti tossed in squid-ink sauce with shrimp, tender squid, fresh mussels, finished with a touch of shrimp bisque, fresh chilli, garlic, and parsley.

shrimp-pasta.name: Shrimp Pasta
shrimp-pasta.desc: Spaghetti, shrimp, seafood sauce, garlic, chilli, Padano cheese
shrimp-pasta.notes: Tender spaghetti with succulent shrimp, tossed in a light seafood sauce with fresh garlic, a hint of chilli, finished with fresh Padano cheese and parsley.

bolognese-pasta.name: Bolognese Pasta
bolognese-pasta.desc: Tagliatelle, Bolognese sauce, Padano cheese, parsley
bolognese-pasta.notes: Wide, tender tagliatelle dressed in a slow-simmered Bolognese of ground beef and tomato, topped with fresh Padano and a scatter of fresh parsley.

pesto-pasta-chicken-panko.name: Pesto Pasta & Chicken Panko
pesto-pasta-chicken-panko.desc: Tagliatelle, pesto sauce, padano cheese, chicken thigh
pesto-pasta-chicken-panko.notes: Silky tagliatelle coated in fresh basil pesto, topped with golden panko-crusted chicken thigh, finished with shaved Padano cheese.

carbonara-pasta.name: Carbonara Pasta
carbonara-pasta.notes: Authentic carbonara: spaghetti tossed with crispy bacon, creamy egg sauce, and fresh Padano cheese. No cream, just tradition.

pannacotta.name: Pannacotta
pannacotta.notes: Silky-smooth Italian cream set with gelatin, served chilled and topped with fresh berries and a light berry coulis. Delicate and refined.

tiramisu.name: Tiramisu
tiramisu.desc: Classic Italian dessert with mascarpone and espresso
tiramisu.notes: Layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and creamy mascarpone, topped with a dusting of bitter cocoa powder. The Italian classic, done right.

pizza-four-cheese.name: Pizza Four Cheese
pizza-four-cheese.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Gorgonzola, Piatone, Taleggio
pizza-four-cheese.notes: Crispy wood-fired crust topped with four distinct cheeses—creamy mozzarella, sharp Gorgonzola, soft piattone, and nutty taleggio. A cheese-lover's dream.

pizza-chicken-unagi.name: Pizza Chicken Unagi
pizza-chicken-unagi.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Chicken thigh, Katsuo, Unagi sauce
pizza-chicken-unagi.notes: Tender chicken thigh, sweet unagi sauce, topped with bonito flakes that dance in the heat, finished with creamy mozzarella. East meets Italy.

pizza-shrimp-mayo.name: Pizza Shrimp Mayo
pizza-shrimp-mayo.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Shrimp, Mayo sauce, Broccoli, Red onion
pizza-shrimp-mayo.notes: Succulent shrimp and tender broccoli florets, creamy mayo sauce, sweet red onion, all on a crispy pizza crust with melted mozzarella.

pizza-soy-beef.name: Pizza Soy Beef
pizza-soy-beef.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Beef belly, Soy sauce, Microgen
pizza-soy-beef.notes: Rich beef belly cooked in soy sauce, tender young microgreens, creamy mozzarella on a crispy base. A fusion of flavors on a thin crust.

pizza-meatlove.name: Pizza Meatlove
pizza-meatlove.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Salami, Bacon, Tomato sauce
pizza-meatlove.notes: A carnivore's fantasy—spicy salami, crispy bacon, sweet tomato sauce, and molten mozzarella on a perfectly charred crust. For the meat-lovers.

pizza-njuda-mushroom.name: Pizza Njuda & Mushroom
pizza-njuda-mushroom.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Homemade njuda, Mix mushroom, Tomato sauce
pizza-njuda-mushroom.notes: Spicy house-made nduja spread generously, sautéed mushroom medley, sweet tomato sauce, melted mozzarella. Heat and earthiness in harmony.

pizza-margherita.name: Pizza Margherita
pizza-margherita.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Tomato sauce, Basil
pizza-margherita.notes: The eternal classic—sweet tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, fresh basil, olive oil on a thin wood-fired crust. Perfect simplicity.

pizza-veggie.name: Pizza Veggie
pizza-veggie.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Tomato sauce, Bell pepper, Mix Mushroom
pizza-veggie.notes: A colorful celebration of vegetables—roasted bell peppers, sautéed mushroom trio, sweet tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella on a crispy crust.

pizza-parma-burrata.name: Pizza Parma & Burrata
pizza-parma-burrata.desc: Dough pizza, Mozzarella, Tomato sauce, Basil, Parma ham, Burrata cheese
pizza-parma-burrata.notes: Tomato sauce and mozzarella base, topped after the oven with delicate Parma ham, creamy burrata, fresh basil, and a drizzle of fine olive oil.

pizza-seafood.name: Pizza Seafood
pizza-seafood.desc: Dough pizza, Seafood sauce, Mozzarella, Squid, Shrimp, Mussel
pizza-seafood.notes: A briny treasure—tender squid, plump shrimp, fresh mussels, light seafood sauce, creamy mozzarella on a wood-fired crust. For seafood aficionados.

smoked-beef-quesadillas.name: Smoked Beef Quesadillas
smoked-beef-quesadillas.desc: Smoked beef, tortilla, avocado, mozzarella, coleslaw, guacamole, salsa
smoked-beef-quesadillas.notes: Tender smoked beef in a crisp tortilla, layered with creamy avocado, melted mozzarella, tangy coleslaw, fresh guacamole, and house-made salsa.

chicken-quesadillas.name: Chicken Quesadillas
chicken-quesadillas.desc: Chicken thigh, tortilla, avocado, mozzarella, coleslaw, guacamole, salsa
chicken-quesadillas.notes: Juicy chicken thigh folded in a crispy tortilla with ripe avocado, melted mozzarella, crisp coleslaw, fresh guacamole, and tangy salsa. A favorite.

smoked-beef-burrito.name: Smoked Beef Burrito
smoked-beef-burrito.desc: Smoked beef, tortilla, mozzarella, coleslaw, bbq sauce, guacamole, salsa, french fries
smoked-beef-burrito.notes: A hefty burrito packed with smoky beef, melted mozzarella, tangy coleslaw, spicy BBQ sauce, creamy guacamole, and fresh salsa. Served with hand-cut fries.

chicken-burritos.name: Chicken Burritos
chicken-burritos.desc: Chicken thigh, tortilla, mozzarella, coleslaw, honey mustard sauce, guacamole, salsa, french fries
chicken-burritos.notes: Generous chicken thigh wrapped in a warm tortilla with creamy guacamole, fresh salsa, honey-mustard sauce, coleslaw, and melted mozzarella. Fries included.

smoked-beef-nachos.name: Smoked Beef Nachos
smoked-beef-nachos.desc: Smoked beef, tortilla, guacamole, salsa, cheese sauce, Padano cheese
smoked-beef-nachos.notes: Crispy tortilla chips heaped with smoky beef, creamy guacamole, fresh salsa, rich cheese sauce, and shaved Padano. A feast for sharing.

chicken-nachos.name: Chicken Nachos
chicken-nachos.desc: Chicken thigh, tortilla, guacamole, salsa, cheese sauce, Padano cheese
chicken-nachos.notes: Loaded tortilla chips with tender chicken, fresh guacamole, tangy salsa, creamy cheese sauce, and shaved Padano. A delicious shared plate.

smoked-beef-tapas.name: Smoked Beef Tapas
smoked-beef-tapas.desc: Smoked beef, french fries, onion, bbq sauce, honey mustard sauce, garlic mayo sauce
smoked-beef-tapas.notes: Hand-cut fries topped with smoky beef, caramelized onion, and a choice of three house-made sauces: BBQ, honey mustard, or spiced garlic mayo.

smoked-beef-taco.name: Smoked Beef Taco
smoked-beef-taco.desc: Smoked Beef, Salsa, Coleslaw, Guacamole, Taco
smoked-beef-taco.notes: A simple, satisfying taco—tender smoked beef, fresh salsa, crisp coleslaw, creamy guacamole, all in a soft corn tortilla.

chicken-taco.name: Chicken Taco
chicken-taco.desc: Chicken thigh, Salsa, Coleslaw, Guacamole, Taco
chicken-taco.notes: Juicy chicken thigh, fresh salsa, crisp coleslaw, creamy guacamole, wrapped in a warm corn tortilla. Quick, satisfying, delicious.

french-fries.name: French Fries
french-fries.notes: Twice-fried golden potatoes, crispy outside and fluffy inside, served with our house spiced garlic mayo for dipping.

chicken-unagi.name: Chicken Unagi
chicken-unagi.notes: Tender chicken thigh glazed in sweet unagi sauce, topped with dancing bonito flakes. A Japanese-inspired comfort dish.

chicken-popcorn.name: Chicken Popcorn
chicken-popcorn.notes: Bite-sized pieces of crispy fried chicken thigh, perfectly seasoned and served with our house spiced garlic mayo. A crowd-pleaser.
